source_notes: Compiled from Deccan Herald, OpenCity, TheFederal and related public reporting on Bengaluru road infrastructure (BBMP/GBA/BDA/BSMILE/NHAI projects), Sept 2026. Corridor paths are approximate route sketches through named junctions, not survey-grade alignments — DPRs for several BSMILE corridors are not yet public in full.

legend.flyover: Elevated road bridge over a junction/stretch
legend.underpass: Road passing below a junction/rail line
legend.grade_separator: Flyover or underpass separating conflicting traffic at a junction

projects.name: Bengaluru Tunnel Road Project (Hebbal–Silk Board)
projects.expected_completion: DPR stage; under legal challenge (Karnataka HC PIL, Oct 2025)
projects.description: Twin-tube underground road tunnel linking Hebbal to Central Silk Board, running beneath central Bengaluru including under Lalbagh Botanical Garden (~700m stretch, 6 acres of land needed inside the garden for a TBM shaft). Ramp planned near Ashoka Pillar and an exit near Marigowda Junction, Siddapura Road. Contested over environmental impact on Lalbagh's rock formation and lake.

projects.name: SV Road Metro–Silk Board Elevated Corridor (via 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar)
projects.expected_completion: Approved by state govt; facing resident backlash over tree loss, land takeover not fully consulted (as of mid-2026)
projects.description: 11.62 km elevated flyover from Swami Vivekananda Road Metro Station (Old Madras Road) through Indiranagar's 80 Feet Road, CMH Road and the tree-lined 100 Feet Road, continuing to Madiwala and on to Silk Board Junction on Hosur Road.

projects.name: Ejipura Flyover
projects.expected_completion: Deadline pushed to March 2026; 437 of 762 precast segments installed as of late 2025
projects.description: Long-delayed flyover on Hosur Road near Ejipura/Koramangala meant to help commuters skip several junctions between Madiwala underpass and the Bosch/MICO office. Originally awarded 2017, stalled mid-construction, reassigned to a new contractor. Needs 2 land parcels near St John's Hospital for ramp construction.

projects.name: Nagavara Junction–Bagalur Main Road Flyover (via R K Hegde Nagar)
projects.expected_completion: DPR finalised, tender out for third-party DPR proof-check (2026)
projects.description: Proposed elevated flyover connecting Nagavara Junction to Bagalur Main Road via R K Hegde Nagar, part of BSMILE's 13-corridor, 126 km package.

projects.name: Mother Teresa Circle (Ulsoor Lake)–Bagalur Village Elevated Corridor (via Assaye Road)
projects.expected_completion: DPR finalised, tender out for third-party DPR proof-check (2026)
projects.description: 27.19 km elevated corridor running from Mother Teresa Circle at Ulsoor Lake Junction, via Assaye Road, up to Bagalur Village on New Airport Road — one of BSMILE's 13 proposed elevated corridors.

projects.name: Old Madras Road–Electronic City Flyover (via SV Road Metro, Indiranagar)
projects.expected_completion: DPR finalised, tender out for third-party DPR proof-check (2026)
projects.description: 10.81 km flyover proposed from Old Madras Road to the existing Electronic City flyover, routed via Swami Vivekananda Road Metro Station, Indiranagar — overlaps in part with the 100 Feet Road elevated corridor proposal.

projects.name: Sirsi Circle–Nayandahalli Elevated Corridor (Mysuru Road)
projects.expected_completion: DPR finalised, tender out for third-party DPR proof-check (2026)
projects.description: 5.22 km elevated corridor along Mysuru Road connecting Sirsi Circle to Nayandahalli.

projects.name: Marenahalli (Ragigudda Junction)–Kanakapura Main Road Elevated Corridor
projects.expected_completion: DPR finalised, tender out for third-party DPR proof-check (2026)
projects.description: 18.47 km elevated corridor from Marenahalli Main Road at Ragigudda Junction to Kanakapura Main Road, running along the BWSSB Pipeline Road.

projects.name: Ullal Main Road Grade Separator (RR Nagar–Kengeri ORR)
projects.expected_completion: Started Nov 2020; incomplete as of 2026, GBA now targets 2026
projects.description: Grade separator across Ullal Main Road on the RR Nagar–Kengeri stretch of the Outer Ring Road; one of Bengaluru's most delayed road projects.

projects.name: HMT Road Pipeline Junction Grade Separator (RR Nagar–Kengeri ORR)
projects.expected_completion: Started Nov 2020; incomplete as of 2026, GBA now targets 2026
projects.description: Grade separator at the HMT Road pipeline junction on the RR Nagar–Kengeri Outer Ring Road stretch.

projects.name: Jalahalli Circle Grade Separator
projects.expected_completion: Announced 2019; work not started — stalled by land acquisition
projects.description: Proposed grade separator at Jalahalli Circle; yet to break ground due to unresolved land acquisition.

projects.name: Annapoorneshwari Nagar Grade Separator (Kengeri ORR)
projects.expected_completion: Announced 2022; stalled since due to a cost overrun of ~Rs 1.5 crore, revised estimate approved recently
projects.description: Grade separator across Annapoorneshwari Nagar on the Kengeri stretch of the Outer Ring Road.

projects.name: Hebbal Junction Underpass
projects.expected_completion: Approved and started 2026; ~1 year construction timeline
projects.description: BDA underpass at Hebbal Junction giving direct access along the Outer Ring Road between KR Puram and Tumakuru Road, alongside an ongoing elevated ramp project from KR Puram to the city centre.

projects.name: Sadahalli Underpass (Airport Road)
projects.description: Six-lane underpass on NH44 Airport Road about 500m from Sadahalli toll plaza, roughly 6m below road level, removing the last signal for airport-bound traffic. Built cut-and-cover; four temporary service lanes added on each side during construction.

projects.name: Hennur Main Road Flyover (Nagawara–Kalyan Nagar)
projects.expected_completion: Long pending since 2012 due to land acquisition near Lingarajapuram; underpass portion (Nagawara–Kalyan Nagar) already complete
projects.description: Flyover on Hennur Main Road widened from 2 to 4 lanes and extended by 600m after resolving land acquisition (39.13 guntas, ~Rs 62 crore paid to landowners) and relocating a temple in Kacharakanahalli.

projects.name: Peripheral Ring Road / Bengaluru Business Corridor
projects.description: 73 km, 8-lane access-controlled expressway ringing outer Bengaluru from Tumkur Road (northwest) to Hosur Road (south) via Hessarghatta, Doddaballapur Road, Old Madras Road and Sarjapur Road. Includes 16 flyovers, 10 overpasses, 12 underpasses and bridges over 7 water bodies including Gunjur Lake. Meant to divert heavy commercial traffic off the Outer Ring Road.
